text:
# SEO and GEO audit: quay-store (SvelteKit)

The repo is small: 3 routes, plus `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml`. The findings are ranked by severity.

## Critical

**1. Client-side rendering only. Crawlers get an empty page.**
- `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` sets `export const ssr = false;`
- The server sends an empty shell. The `<title>`, meta tags, canonical links, JSON-LD, `<h1>` and body copy only exist after JavaScript runs.
- Googlebot can render JS, but it does so late and unreliably. Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others) don't run JS at all. They will see no content from this site.
- **Fix:** delete the line, or set `ssr = true`. Add `export const prerender = true;` for these static pages.

**2. `robots.txt` blocks Googlebot from the whole site.**
- `static/robots.txt:4-5` has `User-agent: Googlebot` followed by `Disallow: /`.
- A bot follows the most specific group that matches it. Googlebot therefore ignores the `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` group, and nothing on the site gets crawled by Google.
- **Fix:** delete lines 4-5. If you meant to block something, use a specific path such as `Disallow: /search`.

## High

**3. The shop page has an empty meta description.**
- `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` has `content=""`.
- Google will make up a snippet, and AI answers get no summary of the page.
- **Fix:** write a real description, for example "Bilge pumps, cleats and rope for boats, shipped next day."

**4. The JSON-LD on the shop page is minimal and fragile.**
- `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5` has a `Product` with only a `name`. Google's Product rich results need `image`, plus `offers` (price, currency, availability) or `review`/`aggregateRating`. As written it adds no rich-result value.
- This page is a listing page, not a single product, so `CollectionPage` or `ItemList` fits better. Use `Product` on individual product pages.
- It is built with `{@html ...}`, which gives no escaping. Any dynamic value put into it later could inject script.
- **Fix:** generate it with `JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/</g, '\\u003c')`. Add the missing fields, or change the type.

**5. `<html>` has no `lang` attribute.**
- `src/app.html:2` has `<html>`.
- This hurts accessibility and language targeting.
- **Fix:** use `<html lang="en">`. The `£` in the layout suggests `en-GB`.

**6. There is no viewport meta tag.**
- `src/app.html:4-5` has no `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />`.
- Without it, mobile rendering is poor, and Google indexes mobile-first.
- **Fix:** add that tag.

## Medium

**7. The layout hides the delivery promise from snippets.**
- `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7` has `data-nosnippet` on "Free delivery over £50."
- That is useful commercial information for search results and AI answers, and the attribute stops it being quoted.
- **Fix:** remove the attribute, unless you really don't want it shown.

**8. The search page has no description or canonical link.**
- `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:1-4` has `noindex`, which is correct. The title "Search" is generic.
- It's low priority. If search URLs get linked internally, consider `noindex, follow`.

**9. The title tags are weak.**
- `src/routes/+page.svelte:2` has "Quay: boat parts".
- `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:2` has "Shop all parts".
- The shop title has no brand name and no keywords. The home title is short.
- **Fix:** use a pattern like "Boat Parts & Marine Chandlery | Quay" and "Shop Bilge Pumps, Cleats & Rope | Quay".

**10. The home page has almost no content, and no Open Graph or Twitter tags exist anywhere.**
- `src/routes/+page.svelte:7` has just an `<h1>`.
- No `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` or `twitter:card` appear in the repo.
- Link previews and AI summarisers will have little to work with.
- **Fix:** add intro copy and category links. Put OG tags in a shared head component.

## GEO / structured data gaps

**11. There is no site-wide schema.**
- No `Organization`, `WebSite` or `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD exists in `src/routes/+layout.svelte` or on the home page.
- It helps entity recognition in search and AI answers.
- **Fix:** add `Organization` (name, url, logo, `sameAs`) in the layout head.

**12. There is no `llms.txt`, and `robots.txt` doesn't mention AI crawlers.**
- Add `static/llms.txt` describing the site and its key pages. This is optional and its benefit is unproven.
- Decide explicitly which AI bots you allow (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).

## Smaller points

- **`sitemap.xml`** (`static/sitemap.xml:3-4`): the entries have no `<lastmod>`. It's hardcoded, so new routes need adding by hand. The sitemap is fine otherwise, and it correctly leaves out `/search`. Consider generating it with a `+server.ts` endpoint.
- **`src/app.html:8`**: the extra `<div>` around `%sveltekit.body%` is unneeded. SvelteKit's default is `<div style="display: contents">`.
- **Layout** (`src/routes/+layout.svelte:5`): the nav has no `<a href="/search">`, so the search page can't be reached. This is fine for a `noindex` page.
- **`https://quay.example`** is a placeholder domain in the canonicals, sitemap and robots. Replace it with the real production domain before launch.
- **`package.json`** has no `@sveltejs/adapter-*` and no `vite` or `@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte` dependency. The `build` script won't work as it stands, and I haven't tried a build. Add an adapter (`adapter-static` suits prerendering).

## Fix order
1. Remove `ssr = false` (#1).
2. Fix `robots.txt` (#2).
3. Fill in the shop meta description (#3).
4. Add `lang` and viewport (#5, #6).
5. Fix the JSON-LD (#4).
6. Add OG tags and `Organization` schema (#10, #11).

I only read the files. I haven't changed anything.
